responsibility: Provides the common target configuration layer for Arm targets using ELF object format. It defines default assembler and linker specs, ELF-specific asm output conventions such as function declaration/size emission, jump-table placement, constructor/destructor hooks, PIC-related GOT/PLT relocation policy, alignment directives, and some libgcc build-condition overrides, forming the base ELF environment inherited by more specialized Arm OS target headers.
